subject: Condensed exec summary for investor packet — approval & redline asks
messages:
From: Liza Chen <liza@oakmontcap.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:23:00 -0800
Subject: Request: condensed exec summary for our upcoming review

Mina — thanks for the quick sync earlier. Oakmont would like a condensed 1-page executive summary (PDF) we can include in the investor packet for our next call (Dec 14). Key asks from our side:

- One-paragraph narrative (what changed since the last deck)
- Top 3 metrics (ARR growth, cost per inference, p50 latency) with short bullets
- One short note on go-to-market progress and top customer stories

Can you get a first pass to me and legal by EOD next Tuesday (Dec 7)? If you need to push, tell me how much time. Attaching last quarter's packet for reference.

Thanks — Liza
Liza Chen
Principal, Oakmont Capital

Attachment: oakmont_last_packet_Q3.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Liza Chen <liza@oakmontcap.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: condensed exec summary for our upcoming review

Liza — thanks, will do. Team — I’m pulling a one-page condensed executive summary to satisfy Oakmont and the board packet. Plan: draft today/tomorrow, internal redline pass Dec 3, legal review request Dec 4–6, final to Liza and DocuSign-ready by EOD Dec 7.

Quick asks for owners:
- Jonas: can you extract p50 latency and cost per inference trend for last 90 days (bullet + single-cell chart)?
- Marissa: two-sentence GTM progress blurb and one customer highlight (name and 1-line impact).
- Neha: will own legal/PII phrasing and gate final wording; can you confirm SLAs language we can show?

I’ll attach the draft v1 to this thread once ready. If anyone cannot meet these timings, flag now.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

Attachment: exec_summary_draft_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: condensed exec summary for our upcoming review

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 9:12 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jonas: can you extract p50 latency and cost per inference trend for last 90 days (bullet + single-cell chart)?

Attached is a minimal metrics table and a PNG you can drop into the one-pager. Highlights:
- ARR QoQ: +18% (driven by 5 midmarket expansions)
- Cost per inference (token normalized): down 12% y/y; 90-day smoothing shown
- p50 latency: 42ms (prod core model) on our hosted service, tail notes included

I kept the chart compact. Let me know if you want a different scale or we need to call out Dedicated/Private splits.

Attachment: QBR_metrics_table.xlsx; latency_chart_90d.png
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: condensed exec summary for our upcoming review

Thanks team — draft looks tight. I pushed a short GTM blurb into the attached PDF and included a customer line for Skylark Health (permission confirmed). Suggested language for customer impact: "Skylark Health reduced triage time by 27% after integrating Redwood’s hosted reranking pipeline (pilot completed Sept)."

Tessa — can you confirm that the customer quote is cleared for public/investor use?

Also recommend we include a one-line color on roadmap risk: estimated model update timeline might shift delivery for private deployments by 2 weeks. Should be concise.

Attachment: exec_summary_draft_v1_marissa_edits.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: LegalOps (contracts@meridianlaw.com)
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: condensed exec summary for our upcoming review

Team — legal reviewed Marissa's customer line; confirmed permissibility for investor packet (we have Skylark’s marketing consent). Two small flagged items:
1) SLA phrasing — change "SLA-backed" to "SLA-aligned" unless we attach the schedule; keeps us accurate.
2) Metrics callouts — avoid naming exact customer revenue impact (use percentages and anonymized phrasing if sensitive).

I’ve attached a redline of the PDF with exact suggested text swaps. If we keep things high-level, we can skip additional contracts review and meet timeline.

Attachment: legal_redlines_contracts.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Liza Chen <liza@oakmontcap.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Final: condensed executive summary (ready for investor packet)

Liza — thanks for the request and patience. Attached is the final one-page condensed executive summary for your investor packet. Summary of changes since the draft:

- Metrics tightened — QoQ ARR +18%; cost per inference down 12% y/y; p50 latency 42ms (hosted).
- GTM: callout for Skylark Health pilot: "reduced triage time by 27%" (consent confirmed).
- Legal edits: SLA language adjusted to "SLA-aligned"; customer references anonymized where required.
- Roadmap note: potential 2-week shift for a private-deploy model update (flagged as risk).

Next steps: please confirm you have what you need for the packet. If approved, we can send the DocuSign-ready version to your legal team and mark this as final for the board packet.

Attachments: exec_summary_final_v1.pdf; QBR_metrics_table.xlsx; legal_redlines_contracts.docx
